meta.source: DEVELOPMENT-MATT.md §4 (measured from the Beli reference screenshots, 393×852pt) + vision.md; brand colour chosen for Bevi

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and card background. Cards are set apart by a 1pt `border` outline, never by a shadow or a second fill.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Grey fills: SearchBar, the BevImage tile tint, Skeleton blocks, the IconButton ✕ circle.

tokens.name: avatarFill
tokens.usage: Avatar circle fill behind initials.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1pt hairlines: row dividers, card and StatCard outlines, outlined Pill and Button borders, the ScoreBubble ring. Decorative separation only; text never sits in this colour.

tokens.name: borderStrong
tokens.usage: Outlines of controls that must be found without their label: outlined Pills, FilterPills, outlined Buttons, TextField and the outlined SearchBar, upcoming ProgressDots. 3.3:1 on `surface` in light, 3.6:1 in dark.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and outline icons, on `surface`, `input` and `avatarFill`.

tokens.name: textSecondary
tokens.usage: Meta lines, labels, timestamps, placeholders, initials, the lock icon; on `surface`, `input` and `avatarFill`. Beli measures #8A8A8E (3.4:1); darkened to clear 4.5:1 on `input` per the plan's accessibility rule.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Bevi grape. Exactly where Beli uses its teal: filled Pills, primary Buttons, the Add tab circle, active underlines on search tabs, a saved bookmark's fill, count badges, StatCard values and icons, SortToggle and "See all" text. As text, on `surface`, `input` and `primaryTint`.

tokens.name: primaryTint
tokens.usage: Active FilterPill background; selected chip fill. `primary` text sits on it.

tokens.name: onPrimary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` fill (Pill filled, Button primary, count badge, the Add tab plus). Dark text in the dark theme because the dark `primary` is light.

tokens.name: scoreHigh
tokens.usage: Loved band (7–10): ScoreBubble number, the Loved BucketButton bar and 12% tint. On `surface`. Beli measures #2E9E5B (3.4:1); darkened to 5.0:1.

tokens.name: scoreMid
tokens.usage: Fine band (4–7): ScoreBubble number, the Fine BucketButton bar and tint. On `surface`. Beli measures #E8B423 (1.9:1 as text); darkened to 4.9:1, which reads amber-brown in light mode.

tokens.name: scoreLow
tokens.usage: Didn't-like band (0–4): ScoreBubble number, the Didn't-like BucketButton bar and tint. On `surface`. Beli measures #D9534F (4.0:1); darkened to 5.2:1. The three score colours share a lightness, so a score is never colour-only: the number or the bucket label always shows.

tokens.name: fizz
tokens.usage: The wordmark's bubbles, one blob of the BevGlow backdrop, and the cover. Decoration only: never text, never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: tasteCard
tokens.usage: Taste Profile share card (Phase 3); stays deep in both themes. `onDeep` text on it (11.4:1).

tokens.name: onDeep
tokens.usage: Text and marks on fills that stay deep in both themes: photos under `photoScrim`, `tasteCard`, `badgeRed`, the inverse wordmark.

tokens.name: badgeRed
tokens.usage: Notification count (not in v1). `onDeep` 11pt bold on it is 3.6:1, below the 4.5:1 rule: darken before it ships.

tokens.name: photoScrim
tokens.usage: Bottom gradient stop on FeaturedCard photos so white title text stays legible on any image.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind an open Sheet.

tokens.name: glassFill
tokens.usage: The liquid-glass material behind BucketButton, blurred 24px over a BevGlow; only on a native build where the OS renders real glass (iOS 26+), never on the web app, where BucketButton is always tint. `text` on it stays at least 9.8:1 in light and 5.7:1 in dark over any glow colour, poured or not.

tokens.name: glassStroke
tokens.usage: The glass rim: a 1px inner edge that catches the light.

tokens.name: glassHighlight
tokens.usage: Specular light on glass: the top sheen, the orb's shine, the bubbles rising in a poured BucketButton.

tokens.name: onScore
tokens.usage: Icons and checks on a score-colour fill (the BucketButton orb and check). White in light, dark ink in dark mode, where the score colours are light.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.display: Fredoka, ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: App
groups.note: The system font everywhere (SF Pro on iOS, Roboto on Android). Sizes are measured from the Beli screenshots in pt. Cap Dynamic Type at 1.3× on dense rows.

styles.name: displayDrop
styles.usage: The ListScopeDropdown label ("All ⌄"). One per screen.

styles.name: screenTitle
styles.usage: Header titles, BevRow names, FeedPost sentences (names bold, verb regular), StatCard values, CompareCard names.

styles.name: tabLabel
styles.usage: SegmentedTabs underline-text labels; ProfileListRow labels and counts.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: ScoreBubble numbers, profile stat numbers, the SortToggle, the @handle, underline-icon tab labels.

styles.name: bodyLarge
styles.sample: Notes: tastes like flat Sprite, in a good way
styles.usage: FeedPost notes, SearchBar placeholder and input text, StatCard labels (semibold).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Meta lines, "Member since", timestamps, Pill and Button labels, brand lines.

styles.name: sectionCaps
styles.usage: Section headers and centred list-screen titles, always uppercase ("YOUR LISTS", "LEADERBOARD").

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Small print: legal line, the rating-count reasons, helper text under fields.

styles.name: tabBar
styles.sample: Feed  Your Lists  Add Bev  Leaderboard  Profile
styles.usage: TabBar labels only; the active tab is bold (700).

groups.name: Brand
groups.note: Fredoka is the wordmark's face. The logo ships as outlined SVG, so the app never loads it; use it only for brand moments outside the app UI (the cover, store art).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Brand art only. In the app, render the Wordmark component (outlined SVG).

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps; gaps between the profile's outlined buttons.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gaps in photo strips and pill rows' inner icon spacing.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Gaps between pills in a row; between stacked compare cards.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Row and card padding; FeaturedCard carousel gap.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Header icon spacing; ProfileListRow icon inset.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Left and right screen gutter on every screen.

radius.note: Named by what they round, as measured on the reference.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Outlined profile Buttons (Edit profile, Share profile, ▼).

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: SearchBar and TextField.

tokens.name: radius-photo
tokens.usage: BevImage tiles and FeaturedCard photos.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and the Sheet's top corners.

tokens.name: radius-stat
tokens.usage: StatCards on the profile.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, FilterPills, badges, avatars, the ScoreBubble.

shadow.note: No elevation on cards: Bevi separates with 1pt `border` outlines, like the reference. Glass is the one thing that floats.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in `surface`, then a solid 2px `primary` ring (10.7:1 light, 8.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: elevation-glass
tokens.usage: Under liquid-glass controls (BucketButton with material=glass, native iOS 26+ only), so they float above the BevGlow. The web app never uses it.

tokens.name: elevation-floating
tokens.usage: Reserved for a floating pill button (Beli's "View Map"); nothing floats in v1.

size.note: Fixed component sizes from the reference, in pt.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target. Smaller visuals (30pt Pills, 28pt icons) extend their hit area to this.

tokens.name: size-header
tokens.usage: Header row height under the status bar.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Header and action-row outline icons; TabBar icons.

tokens.name: size-pill
tokens.usage: Pill and FilterPill height.

tokens.name: size-scoreBubble
tokens.usage: ScoreBubble in rows and posts.

tokens.name: size-scoreBubble-lg
tokens.usage: ScoreBubble on Bev detail and the ranking result.

tokens.name: size-bevImage-strip
tokens.usage: BevImage in FeedPost photo strips, the gut check and Bev detail.

tokens.name: size-featuredCard
tokens.usage: FeaturedCard width and height.

tokens.name: size-row-min
tokens.usage: BevRow height with all four lines.
